dry_runs.dry_run_databases_note: one entry per throwaway database: dryrun-ack/var held two dataset versions of the same 6 patients (one with dry-run release bcff4b46, one without), which the 2026-10-28 package listed as two database entries; the databases of releases ebaba044 and d3815c19 were later reset (pre_fix_inventory.md section 7)
dry_runs.dry_run_test_releases_note: two of the four dry-run databases that held releases were later reset; the inventory lists all four release ids (pre_fix_inventory.md section 7)

overlap_with_real_test_split.detail: Two of the four were dry-run TEST patients scored by dry-run test releases (dry-run models trained on about 4 slides) and their dry-run test predictions were looked at. The other two were dry-run TRAINING patients: their labels were read and their slides were used for the dry-run Macenko references.

dry_runs.required_wording: unreleased in the real study and not used for model selection (never 'untouched')
dry_runs.test_split_slides_extracted_label_free: separately from the dry runs, the real run's feature-set builds extracted all 15 real test slides label-free (fixed encoders, no labels read; allowed by the design); no real-run model scored them
dry_runs.what: Throwaway dry runs of the driver on 6 COBRA slides from 6 patients, imported into separate throwaway databases; every dry run finished before the real split was frozen.

real_cohort.statement: The 15-patient test split of dataset version 1868803e has never been released in the real study. s6 (opt-in test release) was deliberately not run; the decision is the owner's.

note: no test release recorded: no model has been evaluated on the test split and no test metric exists (unreleased and not used for model selection). It is not unread: s1 records its composition (patients and slides per label) and the feature-set builds extract its slides label-free
